observations: body L1-L2: the end of the sentence on Valens begun on p. 309; the addendum to pp. 309–310 (p. LXXIX, Valens in az-Zarqālī, Rabiçag and Abū Naṣr al-Qummī) is recorded on p. 309. A speck stands after the comma following «XLIV)».

body L3-L9: «Ibn Abī Uṣaybi‘ah», «Abū Ma‘shar», «Rabban aṭ–Ṭabarī» (L6), «Thābit», «Ḥunayn al–Qallūsī», «al–Kindī» and «Nawbakht» are letter-spaced; «Rabban aṭ–Ṭabarī» (L3) is not. The ‘ of «Uṣaybi‘ah» prints as a raised point, and a full stop, not a comma, stands after «(1)» before «in vita», as printed. The long dashes of «aṭ–Ṭabarī» (L3, L6), «al–Qallūsī» and «al–Kindī» measure 5.2, 5.3, 4.2 and 5.3 pt. The macron of the ū of «al–Qallūsī» prints broken in two, like a diaeresis.

body L10-L17: «Ptolemaei» (L11), «Abū Ma‘shar» and «az–Zarqālī» are letter-spaced; «Abū Isḥāq» and «Ibn Mu‘ādh» are not. «az–Zarqālī» has a long dash (5.2 pt), and the ‘ of «Mu‘ādh» prints as a raised point. The Latin of L11-L17 renders the Spanish of notes 7 and 8.
body L18-L22: the dash before «Demum» measures 9.6 pt; the d of «proiiciendorum» (L20) prints broken. A full stop stands after «Albumasar» (L21) before «quamvis», as printed.

notes_left L1-L14: «Wüstenfeld», «Steinschneider», «Ibn al-Qifṭī» and «Casiri» are letter-spaced. «ed.» and «Müller» are italic, as printed; a full stop stands after «Wüstenfeld», before the title. The hyphen of «quo-» (L8) did not print. The dash before «Eadem» (L10) measures 5.6 pt, a long dash; «al-anbā’», «al-aṭibbā’», «Kairo-Konigsberg», «308-309», «Ibn al-Qifṭī», «Arabico-Hispana» and «1760-70» have hyphens (2.6 to 3.6 pt). The page of Casiri is printed «436».

notes_left L15-L27: «Suter» (L16, L25, L27) is letter-spaced; «nr 53» (L16) is printed without a full stop. The closing parenthesis of «(3)» prints broken. The hyphens of «Alma-» and «radiatio-» (L20, L21) did not print. The dash before «Ita» (L25) measures 6.4 pt, a long dash. Note 3 ends without a full stop.

notes_right L1-L7: «Steinschneider» and «Suter» (L4, L6) are letter-spaced. The hyphen of «su-» (L1) did not print. «34–» ends L4 with a long dash (4.3 pt) joined to the 4, and L5 begins «-38» with a hyphen (3.1 pt), as printed; a full stop stands after «(nr. 66)». In L6 a raised point stands before «p», which has no full stop.

notes_right L8-L27: the dots after «dixe» (L8) are five. The full stop after «Zarquiel» (L11) did not print. The opening parentheses of «(8)» and «(9)» did not print, and the closing one of «(8)» prints broken. «Ibn Mu‘ādh al-Ǵayyānī» (L20), «Suter» (L21) and «Steinschneider» (L26) are letter-spaced; «Muḥammad» and «Suter» (L22) are not. The dash before «Muḥammad» measures 8.4 pt; «Aben-Mohat» and «al-Ǵayyānī» have hyphens (2.9 and 2.5 pt). «t XIV» (L25) and «M» (L26) are printed without a full stop. Note 9 goes on on p. 311.
